Oprah’s Favorite Things 2026 List Is Here! Published: Nov 12, 2026 7:00 AM EST Share Article Our editors handpick the products that we feature. We may earn commission from the links on this page. 1 min read T HIRTY YEARS AGO , I bought a pair of plaid pajamas that I loved so much, I got them for everyone on my staff. Then a brilliant producer said, “Why don’t you do this for the whole audience?” And that was the start of Favorite Things. I love finding wonderful gifts and sharing them with others. I’m so glad to continue the tradition this holiday season! %0A%09%0A" width="60" height="60" alt="Play video"/> Find the Perfect Gift Stocking Stuffers Stylish Cozy Kids & Family Food & Home Splurge Gifts Wellness Beauty Stocking Stuffers Sunday Silks 3D Contoured Silk Sleep Mask $40 at Amazon “I can’t think of a better stocking stuffer: Wearing one has changed the way I sleep forever, and I promise, they’ll use it every single night. This accommodates lash extensions, provides total blackout, and is great for travel.” Anastasia Beverly Hills Velvet Muse Lip Trio $49 at Amazon $49 at Anastasia Beverly Hills “If you like a matte finish, Anastasia’s lip mousse is perfect. You’d find one in my makeup bag right now. She’s included her bestselling Hush Rose with two new shades.” Uniball Zento Signature Pen $48 at Amazon “A friend who knows I love a good writing pen stood in line at a store in Japan to bring me this one, which is much sought after. (Shops there often only sell one at a time.) Now widely available in the U.S.—it’s for anyone on your list who still writes real notes.” Darn Tough Hiker Micro Crew Midweight Hiking Socks Darn Tough Hiker Micro Crew Midweight Hiking Socks $26 Amazon Also Consider $25 Darn Tough “These are the socks I trust on a trail. Merino wool keeps your feet dry no matter the weather, and they’re still knit at a mill in Vermont. Also, if they ever wear out, send them back for a new pair. For life.” SHOP MEN’S SOCKS Kiehl’s Ultimate Strength Hand Salve $34 at Amazon $33 at Kiehl's “I tried this thick and creamy hand salve with shea butter, avocado oil, and sesame seed oil at a friend’s house. It was so surprisingly good that I now keep one in my purse at all times.” Matador Global Travel Adapter $42 at Amazon $39 at Matador “I’ve been all over the world— usually bringing all sorts of adapters to fit all different plugs. This one works in 170-plus countries, charging up to six devices at once. Anyone with wanderlust will appreciate this snappy device.” SHOP THE LOOK: GAP DENIM FIVE POCKET TOTE . Stylish Rag + Bone Miramar Mallow Trucker Jacket $348 at rag & bone “I liked last year’s version of ‘hard pants that are actually soft pants’ so much that I chose these updates. Each piece is printed to look like denim, but they’re actually a comfy stretch fabric. Gayle wears hers all the time.” SHOP THE MATCHING PANTS Jennifer Fisher 1" Double Lilly Mini Hoops $250 at Jennifer Fisher “I wear hoops a lot. When I saw these two-tone earrings, I put them on. Still wearing them! Mixed metals go with everything.” Stella McCartney Sneak-Elyse $890 at Stella McCartney “The fashion-forward person on your list will love my friend Stella’s cross between a platform and a sneaker. They’re great with jumpsuits, jeans, or a wide-leg pant. I can also tell you they add a few extra inches of height.” Bandolier Dillon Pouchette $168 at Bandolier $168 at Amazon “Know someone who likes to walk out the door with just the essentials? In this leather crossbody, a phone snaps into its own slot and a zip pocket holds cards and keys. It’s light enough that they’ll forget it’s even there.” Echo Half And Half Oversized Silk Square Scarf $199 at Amazon $199 at Echo New York “Silk scarves are having a moment. This 100 percent silk version is 50" x 50" and can be tied around just about anything—shoulders or neck, a bag, or a ponytail. I recently saw women in Paris wearing them around their waists. So chic.” Gap Denim Five Pocket Tote $99.95 at the Gap “Reed Krakoff, who used to be at Coach, designed a handbag line that was an instant hit for the Gap—and aren’t these bags as cute as can be? The rare gift that covers nieces, aunties, and grandmothers.” APL Riviera Sneaker $295 at Athletic Propulsion Labs “Dressy sneakers that are a little retro-looking are in. This low-profile silhouette (in both men’s and women’s versions) is very cute. It’s a great alternative to flats—I wear a pair with suits.” Meta Adventurer Glasses Meta Adventurer Glasses $299 at Meta Also Consider $299 Amazon “Meta’s new line of AI glasses lets you snap photos and videos, play music, take calls, and use Meta AI—all hands-free. As of this year, enjoy the new FDA-cleared hearing enhancement that helps adults with mild to moderate hearing loss.” Aritzia The Super Puff™ Long - cliMATTE™ $375 at Aritzia “Down-filled, water-repellent, and wind-resistant? This is such a good coat to throw on for walking the dog, shoveling snow, or carpool pickup—thanks to side-seam snaps.” Montemaré Vienna Carry-On Tote $268 at Montemare “A great-looking bag for the person who goes from flight to flight. It slides over the handle of a rolly bag and has a padded laptop sleeve and a little safety whistle built into the tassel—such a smart detail.” Arizona Shearling $165 at Birkenstock “My friend Ricky gave me these shearling-lined Birkenstocks, and I wear them constantly in the winter. It’s like a house shoe you can walk out the door in.” Tankaneo Cropped White Shirt $30 at Amazon “I’ve searched far and wide for the perfect white shirt—and this is it. I bought it myself off Amazon, and then saw one just like it in a boutique in Santorini for 15 times the price! I walked out so proud.” SHOP THE LOOK: MARGAUX THE WELLS SHEARLING BOOT . Cozy Ugg Sheepskin Gloves $188 at Amazon $188 at UGG “I have these in my closet in Colorado, so I can tell you these water-resistant gloves are excellent for anyone who thinks winter means cold hands. These will change their mind.” Melifluos Reversible Poncho $31 at Amazon “This shawl is made with a bamboo-based, cashmere-like soft fabric that the person in your life who’s always cold will appreciate. We looked high and low before we found this: It looks great, and the price can’t be beat.
